title: Frost Pass: Snow Defense
short: Hold five mountain lanes against rolling snow creatures with cards. A new pass every day.
desc:
Every night, snow creatures roll down the mountain. Keep the pass safe before all five village lanterns go out.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Play one card per turn to place Throwers, Ice Walls, Braziers and Icicle Traps on the lanes.
- Cards cost firewood, and you gain one each turn. Spend it now, or wait for a bigger play.
- The strip above the board shows where the next creatures will appear.
- Hold 8 waves to win. Between waves, pick one of three reward cards to grow your deck.

TODAY'S PASS
A run set by the date: everyone meets the same creatures and reward cards that day. Your best score for each day goes on a calendar.

FIVE SNOW CREATURES
Snowballs, Sleetlings that move two tiles at a time, Cracked Snowballs that split in two, and tough Boulderballs. Everything you meet fills your field guide.

- Turn-based: stop any time and continue where you left off. About five minutes a run, one hand.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in.

This app was planned and built with the help of AI tools.
